name: Cinnamon-Mill Haven
core_rationale: Central spice-milling sanctuary town of Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff at [1, 1] where Lantern-Keepers grind warm cinnamon-sugar and star-anise glaze above the Spice-Kiln Cellar.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Warm aromatic spice-steeping basins ringed by glazed terracotta millwheels

North.lock_message: Swirling aromatic spice-drafts across Star-Anise Promontory cloud unshielded sightlines; Mill-Steward Clove requires the Star-Pod Lantern before opening the northern promontory.

resident_npcs.name: Mill-Steward Clove
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Cinnamon-Mill Haven! Step up to my 0.58 meter pastry counter for a warm cinnamon-roll fresh from the hearth-mill.

resident_npcs.name: Grinder-Apprentice Nutmeg
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Spice-Kiln Cellar, a giant cinnamon-carapace beetle guards the Star-Pod Lantern needed for Star-Anise Promontory!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff at [1, 1] directly above Sola's Spice-Kiln Cellar and connects west to Cinnamon-Bark Viaduct.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Terracotta spice-mill plaza where warm hearth-breezes turn cinnamon-bark windmills.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58m pastry counters, 0.14m terracotta risers, 2.10m x 1.55m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Star-Anise Promontory behind a Fog of Lore portal requiring the Star-Pod Lantern.
